note: Window camera calibration for kodama836-e-dusk (2026-09-30 revision). Position: data/ride-sync.json on the refined up-track (tools/refine-track.mjs: 5 inbound rides, window-side GPS bias removed). Eye height: the rides' GPS altitude profile (ellipsoidal) + heightOffset. fov 66 (stabilised Pixel video). lateral: window offset from the track centre toward the facing side. keys: yaw/pitch/roll offsets (deg) vs. facing = travel heading - 90, smoothstep-interpolated; src says where each key comes from (skyline = automatic sky-outline match with IoU >= 0.55; tokyo-tower = lit tip position in the frame; visual = side-by-side check in the ghost overlay).
